title: Guitarist Sails on the riverboat and in Ridgley's band
summary: Ridgley says Sails worked in his band, then took a riverboat job and did not return; they discuss his age and his father.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Guitar, no. Did you know Sails? When you were playing music, did you know him very well?
Now he was, Sails was on the boat with us. He was on the boat with us?
Yeah. You mean when Baby Dodge was with you?
Well, yeah. May I say that, did he? I believe he was on that boat with us.
I think he was, yeah. He's a smart kid.
Well, he ought to be talented. His father must have been a pretty good guitar player.
Did he ever work with you in your band, Sails?

Yeah. He worked with us. Sails worked with us until we got on the boat. That's where he got a job on the boat, and he never would come back anymore, you know? I mean, I don't even call it. I worked with many of them.
Sails was old enough to play with you in 1918 or so during the war?
He sure doesn't look old. Mm-hmm.
Your daddy looked good, and he was an old man.
